filters: CL, Fat Pig V2. Baseline: all sidebar filters Any, no chart filter. Stacked case: Next Day Asia IB Close Range vs Today NY Full Session Mid = D, plus London IB to LTN vs Asia IB to ATL UDOI (730pm–3am vs 3am–830am), Next Day = U. The two NY breakout direction filters and false-day filter were Any.
method: The extrema counts come from the displayed Post London IB HL Unordered Combo (Next Day) categories. At least one in ny_after_ib sums london_after_ib & ny_after_ib, ltn_transit & ny_after_ib, ny_after_ib & ny_ib, and ny_after_ib & ny_after_ib. At least one in either NY bucket includes every combination containing ny_ib or ny_after_ib. Both extremum sides are counted as one case, not two. NY range-category U and D counts were read from the chart tooltips for NY Full Session vs Prev NY Full Session (Next Day).
note: A late NY extreme is common in both cohorts; 87.1% versus 85.1% is only about a two-point difference. This does not tell you the size of a remaining move, which boundary breaks first, whether price rises from 08:30, or a trade win rate. U and D above are the site’s range-category codes, not a positive/negative NY return. Other categories account for 225/595 cases.
positionNote: The site’s Asia IB close range is not the Asia full-session 02:00 close. Its London comparison uses 19:30–03:00 versus 03:00–08:30, not the planner’s 19:30–02:00 Asia window. We used Next Day outcomes aligned with that overnight period; Current Day NY breakout fields were left unrestricted. The visible interface did not establish the date span, complete category algorithms, session-bucket clock definitions or contract treatment. Counts stay separate from the local 2022–2026 archive and are not used to calibrate its AVR point forecast.
